question: Revamp the backend framework into FastAPI — or which framework is best for this app?

profile_constraints.runtime: Python 3.10+ embedded ON-DEVICE in the Android APK via Chaquopy
profile_constraints.current_stack: Flask 3.1.3 + stdlib only; proven on-device (current APK runs Flask)
profile_constraints.serves: Flutter Android app (JSON API layer to be built; 41 routes exist as HTML + 9 JSON)
profile_constraints.data: single-file SQLite, 264k-row ISIN master, 12 download channels parsed to canonical records

frameworks.name: FastAPI
strengths: Pydantic models = the Flutter API CONTRACT, machine-checkable; auto OpenAPI/Swagger docs = the API-contract deliverable generates itself (checklist item 4 solved by the framework)
Best JSON ergonomics: validation, typed endpoints, dependency injection
Starlette underneath: background tasks, startup/shutdown events, test client via HTTPX
risks: Pydantic v2 uses pydantic-core (Rust native). Chaquopy must ship an Android wheel for pydantic-core or the install fails on-device - UNVERIFIED, the decisive risk
uvicorn on-device must run pure-Python mode (uvloop/httptools are optional extras and will not build for Android) - workable but slower startup
More dependencies than Flask: bigger APK, longer Chaquopy build
frameworks.embedded_fit: UNVERIFIED - gate with a 30-minute build spike (add fastapi+pydantic to the Chaquopy build; if the wheel resolves, FastAPI is viable)
frameworks.verdict: Best API ergonomics; contingent on the Chaquopy wheel spike

frameworks.name: Flask 3.1.3 (current)
strengths: PROVEN on-device: the current APK embeds and runs Flask today
Lightest dependency footprint; smallest APK impact
All 41 routes already exist; queries/db/service layers framework-agnostic
risks: No automatic request validation or API contract - item 4 (API contract shapes) stays manual

frameworks.name: Litestar
strengths: Fast, pure-Python core option (msgspec validation), pydantic optional
risks: Smaller community; Chaquopy fit unverified (same spike needed)
frameworks.verdict: credible alternative if FastAPI's pydantic-core wheel fails and msgspec (pure wheel or sdist) resolves instead

frameworks.name: Django / Django-Ninja
risks: ORM/admin/migrations machinery is dead weight for a single-file SQLite offline app; heavy for embedded

frameworks.name: Stdlib-only (extend current pattern)
strengths: Zero new deps; current 41 routes already work
risks: Manual JSON validation; manual contract doc; every new endpoint hand-rolled
frameworks.verdict: fallback if all frameworks fail the Chaquopy spike

serving_mode_insight.point: With Flutter + Chaquopy the backend has TWO serving modes, and the framework question changes with each
serving_mode_insight.mode_A: Localhost HTTP server inside the app (current WebView pattern continues; Flutter calls 127.0.0.1). Framework = real (Flask/FastAPI/uvicorn). The locked JSON contract applies.
serving_mode_insight.mode_B: Direct Python bridge via platform channels (no HTTP server, no port, no socket). The framework question dissolves: what remains is a router + validation layer (FastAPI-style routing without uvicorn, or plain functions + pydantic/manual validation). Lighter and faster on-device; bigger Flutter-side refactor.
serving_mode_insight.note: The locked JSON contract (routes + shapes) is IDENTICAL in both modes - the contract survives the choice; only the transport changes.

recommendation.decision_gate: 30-minute Chaquopy build spike: add fastapi + pydantic to the Android build; if the pydantic-core Android wheel resolves, adopt FastAPI; if not, evaluate Litestar/msgspec; if neither, Flask stays and the contract is hand-documented.
recommendation.recommended_primary: FastAPI - pending the wheel spike. It directly produces the API contract (checklist item 4) as a maintained artifact, matches the outside-in design order, and its dependency injection fits our service/cache/provenance layering.
recommendation.recommended_fallback: Flask 3.1.3 stays (proven) + written contract; revisit per release.
recommendation.what_survives_any_choice: routes list, queries/, db.py, bond_master service/cache/adapters, scheduler, 717-test suite (mostly), the locked JSON contract

evidence.chaquopy_flutter_pattern: https://mindster.com/mindster-blogs/run-python-in-flutter-chaquopy/ - Flutter + Kotlin host + embedded CPython pattern
evidence.pydantic_core_android_wheel: UNVERIFIED - the decisive open fact; gate = build spike
